abstract: Let $J_0^D(M)$ be the Jacobian of the Shimura curve $X_0^D(M)$ attached to an indefinite quaternion algebra of discriminant $D>1$ over $\mathbf{Q}$ and an Eichler order of level $M$, and let $g$ be its genus. For $D=1$, Jorgenson and Kramer proved $h_F(J_0(N))\sim\frac{g}{3}\log N$ for squarefree $N$ prime to $6$; for $D>1$ the size of the Faltings height in terms of the level has been open. We prove that if $N=DM$ is squarefree and prime to $6$ and $g\ge2$, then $12\,h_F(J_0^D(M))\ge 4(g-1)\big[\sum_{q\mid D}\frac{q}{q-1}\log q+\sum_{p\mid M}\frac{p}{p+1}\log p\big]-C\big(g+2^{\omega(N)}\log N\big)$ with an absolute constant $C$, hence $h_F(J_0^D(M))\ge(\frac13-o(1))\,g\log N$ uniformly in $(D,M)$. The proof applies the arithmetic Riemann-Roch theorem of Freixas i Montplet and von Pippich for orbifold curves. The self-intersection of the orbifold canonical bundle is computed from Yuan's modular height formula and an error-free level-raising recursion on the normal coarse model, in which thick nodes enter through Mumford intersection numbers and the Eichler mass formula. We also show that elliptic sections are disjoint at primes $\ge5$ and have bounded intersections at $2$ and $3$, compute their heights, and give a one-sided bound for the Selberg zeta value. As a consequence, inside an explicitly stated exponent-profile relaxation model that retains Pasten's separate bound $v_2(abc)\ll_\epsilon R^\epsilon$, the Petersson-ratio channel of Pasten's Shimura-curve approach to abc cannot lower the Stewart-Yu exponent $1/3$ on an infinite family of triples whose Frey curves have conductor prime to $6$; this obstruction is forced by the height bound, not by the model. We claim no upper bound or asymptotic for the height, and nothing about the abc conjecture itself. The manuscript was produced with AI research agents and has not been reviewed by a human expert.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
1. Section 7.7: when quoting [27, Theorem 1.1], l is now defined as any prime not dividing N (as in the source).
2. Corollary 7.4: the discriminant comparison is now written as log|Delta| << max{1,h(E)} [27, (1.1)], followed by h(E) << N [27, Corollary 1.3].
3. References: added the missing volume of [3] (Duke Math. J. 87) and volume/pages of [7] (JEMS 22, 3491-3564).
4. Corollary 1.2: the step d_M=phi(D)psi(M)/6 >= phi(N)/6 is now written out.
5. Section 4.6: the normalisation of delta_p over K (p unramified, [K:Q]=4) is stated.
6. Introduction and Section 7.7: precise theorem numbers added for [1],[2],[9],[10],[13],[15],[17],[21],[25]; volumes/pages added for [2],[6],[13],[16],[17].
7. Proof of Proposition 3.2, case p not dividing N: the ordinary case is now treated explicitly (commutative endomorphism algebra) and the correspondence supersingular/inert, ordinary/split is stated.\nNo change to statements of theorems or to the supplement.
title: A uniform lower bound for the Faltings height of Jacobians of Shimura curves X_0^D(M)
